title: Comparison of strict and enhanced system operation models
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R$, a uniformizer $\varpi$, and $A_n=R/\varpi^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. All schemes below have $\ell$ invertible and use small pro-etale sites in the fixed universes [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. For each scheme $W$, set $B_{W,n}=(A_n)_W$ and $\widehat R_W=\lim_nB_{W,n}$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Let $\mathscr S_W$ be the ordinary category of $B_{W,n}$-module systems with quotient-linear transitions and $D(\mathscr S_W)$ its unbounded derived category [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections].

Let $j:X\hookrightarrow Z$ be an open immersion and $p:Z\to Y$ a morphism [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. On the ringed sequence sites [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site], let $J_j^{\mathrm{str}}$ be exact extension by zero and let $S_p^{\mathrm{str}}=Rp_{*,\bullet}$ be the total right derived functor of levelwise $p_*$ on the whole system category. Write $e_n$ for evaluation at level $n$, $\tau^M_{m,n}:e_mM\to\operatorname{Res}_{m,n}e_nM$ ($m\geq n$) for the transitions of a system $M$ and $t^M_{m,n}$ for their extension-form adjoints, and $U_Y$ for termwise restriction of scalars along $\widehat R_Y\to B_{Y,n}$ to strict $\widehat R_Y$-module towers. Let $b_{m,n}$ be the coefficient mate of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections] for the direct image along $p$. For $M\in D(\mathscr S_X)$ put $T_n(M)=\operatorname{Res}_nRp_{*,n}j_!e_nM\in D(\widehat R_Y)$, and for $m\geq n$ give these objects the transition $T_m(M)\to T_n(M)$ equal to $\operatorname{Res}_m$ of the transpose, under $-\otimes^L_{B_{Y,m}}B_{Y,n}\dashv\operatorname{Res}_{m,n}$, of
$$Rp_{*,n}\bigl(t^{N}_{m,n}\bigr)\circ b_{m,n,N_m},\qquad N=J_j^{\mathrm{str}}M,$$
where the system $N$ has the levelwise transitions $j_!(\tau^M_{m,n})$; here $\operatorname{Res}_m\operatorname{Res}_{m,n}=\operatorname{Res}_n$. Then for every $M\in D(\mathscr S_X)$ there are natural isomorphisms in $D(\widehat R_Y)$
$$\Theta_{M,n}:\operatorname{ev}_n\bigl(U_Y S_p^{\mathrm{str}}J_j^{\mathrm{str}}M\bigr)\xrightarrow{\sim}T_n(M)\qquad(n\geq1),$$
each the canonical evaluation identification $\operatorname{ev}_nU_Y=\operatorname{Res}_ne_n$ followed by $e_nS_p^{\mathrm{str}}\cong Rp_{*,n}e_n$ and $e_nJ_j^{\mathrm{str}}=j_!e_n$, and they carry every transition of the tower $U_YS_p^{\mathrm{str}}J_j^{\mathrm{str}}M$ to the transition of $(T_n(M))_n$ just defined. Thus $\Theta_M=(\Theta_{M,n})_n$ is an isomorphism of whole towers of objects of $D(\widehat R_Y)$. The family is compatible with the units and counits of the open and direct-image adjunctions, natural for every derived morphism of systems, and constructed before taking any inverse limit.

proof.text: Obtain normalized actual operation presentations and the four unit/counit equations from [lem-trf-compact-support-normalized-presentation]. Define theta_n to be compactSupportSystemEvaluationIso, the canonical composite of restricted evaluation, direct-image evaluation and open evaluation. This gives the six normalization clauses and the canonical-theta clause directly.

For N=J_j M and P=Rp_{*,bullet}N, use [lem-trf-direct-image-restriction-transition] to identify the restriction-form direct-image transition. Expand the scalar-adjunction homEquiv of b followed by Rp_n of the adjunct input transition. The identity unit_mateEquiv_symm, naturality of the coefficient restriction square, and homEquiv.apply_symm_apply identify this transpose with Rp_m(tau_N) followed by the derived coefficient comparison. This is the proved private restriction_mate_transpose calculation.

Use [lem-trf-completed-restriction-transition] to pass from the actual source tower transition to the completed restriction of the quotient-linear transition of P. Naturality of the specified restriction-composition iso moves the right direct-image comparison across it. Substitute the direct-image transition square from the preceding step. The open-evaluation hom at level m cancels its inverse inside the target transition. The remaining word is exactly theta_m followed by compactSupportSystemTargetTransition. The proved private evaluated_tower_square carries out this composition and cancellation.

Package the canonical theta and the transition equality with the six normalization assertions and four adjunction equations into CompactSupportSystemEvaluationWitness. The naturality is that of the natural isomorphisms used to define theta, and all constructions precede the inverse limit.
